status_at_creation: Protocol fixed after source inspection and before computing new scores; development reanalysis, not a pristine confirmation
question: With the dark-matter contribution fixed at zero, do measured light and independently calibrated stellar-mass corrections account for the observed motions?
gravity: Newtonian throughout the physical mass audit; no fitted halo, RAR interpolation, modified-force correction, or invisible residual component

binary_optical_infrared.source: Benedict et al. 2016, arXiv:1608.04775, active table tbl-MMVMK
binary_optical_infrared.primary: HST/FGS sample only; require both component V and K absolute magnitudes; retain both stars in the same validation group
binary_optical_infrared.target: log10 individual orbital mass in solar units
binary_optical_infrared.validation: Leave one entire binary out; select degree and penalty in three grouped inner folds
binary_optical_infrared.supplementary: The mixed other-mass table is inventoried but not added to the primary calibration because distance provenance is heterogeneous

binary_mass_anchor.source: Mann et al. 2019, CDS J/ApJ/871/63 table1 and table5; external individual masses from article table tab:ind
binary_mass_anchor.training_target: Measured total mass of a binary; never infer component labels using the same mass-luminosity relation
binary_mass_anchor.formula: log10 component mass = degree-5 polynomial in (absolute Ks magnitude - 7.5)/2.5; sum the two predicted component masses for the training comparison
binary_mass_anchor.extra_feature: Shared system metallicity as one additive log-mass coefficient
binary_mass_anchor.fit: Equal-system log-mass squared errors with a linear monotonicity constraint on an 801-point absolute-magnitude grid from 3.5 to 11.5; no claim of reproducing the source's full posterior analysis
binary_mass_anchor.validation: Five deterministic folds of entire systems; then fit the fixed model to all calibration binaries and evaluate nonoverlapping external eclipsing-binary systems
binary_mass_anchor.uncertainty: Bootstrap systems; shared-parallax sensitivity moves absolute magnitudes and orbital mass coherently; external EB mass is distance independent but photometric component separation uses spectral templates
sensitivities: published degree-5 relation as an external-benchmark reproduction

sparc_mass_only.source: Existing exploration-only profiles and matched-concentration quality selection; reserved confirmation remains unused
sparc_mass_only.prediction: V_N^2 = gas_scale * Vgas * abs(Vgas) + alpha * (0.5 * Vdisk^2 + 0.7 * Vbulge^2)
models: one global alpha with five held-galaxy folds
one alpha per galaxy fitted to inner half and tested on outer half
one alpha per galaxy fitted to all radii, explicitly in-sample diagnostic
independent disk and bulge scales, explicitly in-sample diagnostic
sparc_mass_only.scores: Equal-galaxy mean squared log-speed errors, absolute fractional speed errors, invalid circular-force counts; formal velocity errors are not the full covariance
sparc_mass_only.radial_diagnostic: Required alpha at each radius is the multiplier of the whole fixed stellar template that would match that radius; it is not an independently measured local mass profile
sparc_mass_only.transfer_boundary: A Ks relation for individual nearby dwarfs does not calibrate the integrated 3.6-micron M/L of a galaxy. No numerical transfer between those quantities is assumed.

manga_light_only.samples: Existing 585-galaxy development sample and disjoint 243-galaxy transport sample; both historically inspected
manga_light_only.target: log10 stellar velocity dispersion, not circular speed, individual star mass, or excess gravity
additions: g-r plus measured spectral indices and H-alpha equivalent width
manga_light_only.validation: Existing whole-galaxy outer folds, training-only hyperparameter selection, ridge and ExtraTrees with the prior equal model budgets; 243-galaxy transfer untuned on its targets
manga_light_only.limitations: Catalog photometric and spectral summaries, not all raw bands. Original sample selection used catalog mass validity. Spectral indices and dispersion share the spectroscopic pipeline.

implementation_amendment: The first run stopped at a monotonicity assertion in the binary quality sensitivity, after completing only the optical/infrared stage. Replaced a soft penalty with a hard linear constraint; scientific inputs, model degree, comparisons, and validation sets unchanged. Original attempt retained in stellar-mass-audit-001. Completed run uses stellar-mass-audit-002.
